verdicts.reason: Both are near-copies of the original square with no real rearrangement. The top-left decorative circle is enlarged and now crowds the NEW FLAVOR badge and the logo area. Both also keep the original's flaw: the subhead is jammed against the CTA pill with almost no gap. B is slightly worse because the label text in the NEW FLAVOR badge and the 'Shop the Summer Line' button sits a few pixels low, so it is no longer centred vertically in its pill.
